name: LongBench v2
description: Long-context benchmark with 503 challenging multiple-choice questions across 6 real-world categories with contexts 8K-2M tokens. Tests document QA, multi-doc reasoning, in-context learning, dialogue, code, and structured data.
creator: Tsinghua University (THUDM)

dataset.source: Real-world long-context tasks across 6 categories (8K-2M tokens)

notes: Top: o1-preview 57.7% vs human baseline 53.7%. ACL 2025. Tests 8K to 2M token contexts.
